prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, and preferred working style. I can help you find the best fit. A few quick questions will let me give a short, tailored list:

- What type of marketing do you need? (digital/SEO/PPC, social media, branding, creative, B2B lead gen, PR, ecommerce, etc.)
- What’s your monthly/annual budget range for agency work?
- Company size / stage (startup, SMB, enterprise)?
- Do you prefer a local agency (near Baltimore, Annapolis, DC suburbs) or are remote OK?
- Any industry-specific experience required (healthcare, real estate, professional services, fintech, etc.)?
- Timeline / major milestones?

If you want to evaluate agencies yourself, here’s a short checklist and how I’ll approach a curated recommendation:

How to choose an agency (quick checklist)
- Relevant case studies & measurable results (look for KPIs similar to yours)
- Client references and retention rate
- Team expertise and senior involvement (who will actually do the work)
- Specialties match your primary needs (SEO vs. creative vs. performance)
- Reporting cadence and agreed KPIs
- Pricing model and minimum contract length
- Cultural fit and communication style

What I can deliver if you want me to find options
- A short list of 4–6 Maryland-based agencies matched to your needs
- One-paragraph summary of each agency’s strengths and ideal clients
- Example results or case studies (where available) and an estimated budget range
- A shortlist of 6–10 questions to ask them in interviews

Tell me the answers to the questions above (or your top priorities) and I’ll put together a tailored shortlist of Maryland agencies.
